items.title: Citigroup (C) Stock May Be Reasonable As AI Banking Hopes Grow
items.summary: Citigroup stock has delivered a very strong 3 year run, yet current valuation checks and the intrinsic value estimate from the Excess Returns model both still point to the shares trading below that intrinsic value. With the market debate around banks intensifying again, the question is how much of Citigroup’s recent progress is already reflected in the US$135.0 share price.
